## Backend

### Route registration + auth

Canonical: `src/app.ts` L31-32, L120-125; `src/routes.ts`.

```ts
export const PUBLIC = { config: { public: true } } as const;
...
app.addHook('onRequest', async (req) => {
  if (req.routeOptions.config?.public === true) return;
  await authenticate(req, verify);
});
```

- Every route is protected unless declared with `PUBLIC` as its options object. Never add a
  per-route auth hook; read the caller from `req.auth` (`{ userId, tenant, name }`).
- Routes use Fastify JSON schema (`schema: { body/params/querystring }`) with
  `additionalProperties: false`; ajv runs with no coercion, no defaults, no removeAdditional.
- A module exposes an async Fastify plugin `(app: FastifyInstance) => Promise<void>` (same signature
  as `registerRoutes`); only integration tasks wire it into `src/routes.ts`.
- `PUBLIC` routes in this project: `/healthz`, `/onlyoffice/callback`, `/files/:id/content`,
  `/files/:id/versions/:vid/content`, `/dev/token` (each carries its own token check — IA §A).
- Rules: `.claude/rules/backend-patterns.md`, `auth-flow.md`, `api-conventions.md`.

### Errors

Canonical: `src/errors.ts` L5-39.

```ts
throw new AppError('FileNotFound', 'file not found');   // status comes from ERROR_CATALOG
```

- Throw `AppError` with a catalog code; never `reply.status(..).send(..)` an error by hand.
- A new code is added to `ERROR_CATALOG` **and** to `CODES` in `src/logger.ts` (kept literal) **and**
  to IA §F — a code missing from the catalog is a contract change.
- Unknown errors: log `errName` only, answer `500 InternalError`. Never log `err.message`.
- Rules: `error-handling.md` (BE-K/BE-S).

### Config

Canonical: `src/config.ts` L54-87. New settings go through `need(NAME, parse)` (fail-closed,
named in `ConfigError`), become a readonly field on `Config`, and are added to `.env.example`
and the test `ENV`/`valid` fixtures. Secrets: `>= 32` chars. Modules receive `Config`/values via
deps — never read `process.env` outside `loadConfig` (only `server.ts` passes `process.env`).

### Logging

Canonical: `src/logger.ts` L32-55. Log structured fields only from `KEY_SHAPES`
(`reqId, fileId, versionId, userId, tenant, event, component, count, code, errName, ...`);
anything else is dropped. `msg` is a short fixed phrase (no ids, no URLs, no tokens). A new
loggable field means a new `KEY_SHAPES` entry with a strict shape and a logger test.
Rules: `security.md`, `injection-and-credential-safety.md` (INJ).

### DB access

Canonical: `src/db/client.ts`. Use `DbClient.db` (Drizzle `NodePgDatabase`) passed in via deps
or `app.dbClient`; do not create pools in modules. Constants are named (`POOL_MAX`, `*_MS`).
Repositories (`<thing>.repo.ts`) hold all Drizzle queries; services never import `pg`.
Schema/migrations: **NEW PATTERN** (TASK-003). Rules: `database.md`.

### Dependency injection

Canonical: `AppDeps` in `src/app.ts` L34-40. Optional collaborators (db, authenticator, routes)
are injected; missing collaborator → fail closed (`denyAll`, `checkDb(undefined) === false`).
Follow this for `StorageGateway`, `DocumentServerClient`, clocks and job intervals: pass them in,
default to the safe behaviour, so tests inject fakes without module mocking.

### Code style (all of `src/`)

- First line: `// <what this file is> (<FR/NFR/IA ref>): <the one rule it enforces>.`
- Relative imports end in `.js` (NodeNext). `import type` for types.
- Named exports only; `UPPER_SNAKE` constants; `camelCase` functions; files `kebab-case`,
  module files `<module>.routes.ts` / `<module>.service.ts` / `<thing>.repo.ts` (per task briefs).
- `catch (err)`: narrow with `instanceof` and rethrow what you do not expect (see `config.ts`
  `parseHttpUrl` is the one bare `catch {}`, for `new URL`).
- No recursion over untrusted input (iterative walk in `assertStrictJson`).
- Cross-module imports go through the module's public `index.ts` (project-structure rule);
  shared registration points (`src/routes.ts`, `src/jobs.ts`, `buildApp` wiring) are edited only by
  integration tasks.
- Migrations: project rule names them `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql`; drizzle-kit's default
  naming differs, so TASK-003 must pick one (set the drizzle-kit prefix or record the deviation below).

## QA / Tests

### Unit + route tests

Canonical: `tests/foundation/app.test.ts` L1-55, `tests/foundation/config.test.ts`.

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { buildApp, PUBLIC, type Authenticator } from '../../src/app.js';
...
const a = await buildApp({ config, logger: createLogger('debug', (l) => lines.push(l)),
  authenticator, routes: async (inst) => { inst.get('/secret', async () => ({ ok: true })); } });
const res = await a.inject({ method: 'GET', url: '/secret' });
```

- Explicit `vitest` imports (even though `globals: true`). Files `tests/<area>/<name>.test.ts`,
  mirroring `src/modules/<module>/`.
- Route tests build the real app with `buildApp` + `inject`, injecting only the module's routes
  and a fake `Authenticator`; close the app in `afterEach`.
- Logs are asserted by capturing the sink (`createLogger(level, sink)`), never by spying on pino.
- `describe` titles cite the requirement: `'deny-by-default guard (FR-005, IA §A)'`.
- Loop-generated cases for every required/forbidden input (see config test `for (const name of REQUIRED)`).
- Assert the full error body (`{ error: { code, message } }`), plus at least one negative assertion.

### Integration (real Postgres)

Canonical: `tests/helpers/pg.ts` — `startTestPg()` → `{ url, stop }` (postgres:16-alpine via
testcontainers). Never mock the database (NFR-012). Start in `beforeAll`, `stop()` in `afterAll`;
`hookTimeout` is 120 s in `vitest.config.ts`.

### Property-based tests

`tests/pbt/properties.pbt.test.ts` is an unfilled `/pbt` template — **not canonical**. PBT shape is
NEW PATTERN; use fast-check `fc.assert(fc.property(...))` inside a vitest `it`, colocated under
`tests/modules/<module>/`.

## Demo slice (SPIKE — never merged)

`demo/` on branch `demo/slice` is a throwaway end-to-end spike (plain JavaScript ESM, Node 20,
Fastify, `node:test`). It is **untracked**, **not** part of `src/`, and must never be merged or
used as an analog for production code. Production code never imports from `demo/`.

State at mapping time: only the tests exist (`demo/src/{tokens,store,server}.test.js`); the
implementation files and `demo/public/` are not written yet.

| Planned demo file | Analog | Shape rules |
|---|---|---|
| `demo/src/tokens.js` | `demo/src/tokens.test.js` (contract) | exports `documentKey(secret, fileId, versionId)` → 20-char `[0-9A-Za-z_-]`; `signDownloadToken(secret, {fileId, versionId}, now?)`, `verifyDownloadToken(secret, token, fileId)` → payload or `null` (5-min TTL, bound to file). Node `crypto` HMAC only. |
| `demo/src/store.js` | `demo/src/store.test.js` | `openStore(dir)` → `{ createFile, addVersion, readVersion, get }`; disk JSON metadata survives reopen; `addVersion` returns `{ created }`, idempotent on same key+content, no-op when equal to head. |
| `demo/src/server.js` | `demo/src/server.test.js`; production analog for ideas only: `src/app.ts`, `src/errors.ts` | `buildApp({ dataDir, dsJwtSecret, appSecret, dsPublicUrl, dsInternalUrl, appInternalUrl, logger })`; user from `x-demo-user` header (spike only — production uses `req.auth`); errors as `{ error: { code } }` using production catalog names (`UnsupportedFormat`, ...); callback 401 on bad JWT, 500 on save failure. |
| `demo/public/*` | none — **NEW (spike)** | static page loading the Document Server `api.js`; nothing reused by TASK-014. |

Spike rules: `.js` only, `node:test` + `node:assert/strict`, temp dirs via `fs.mkdtemp` and removed
in `after`, fake Document Server as a local `http.createServer` on port 0. Spike-only shortcuts
(header identity, JSON-file store, no encryption) must not migrate into `src/`.

### Note 1 — UI test runner (plan-check G1)
- **When:** 2026-11-25 · **File:** `tests/ui/*.spec.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`, `package.json`
- **Decision:** Playwright (`@playwright/test`), Chromium + Firefox projects (SRS TBD-005). Files `tests/ui/<area>.spec.ts`; run with `npx playwright test` (script `test:ui`); vitest keeps `tests/**/*.test.ts` only, so the two runners never collect each other's files. Locators by role/label (web-qa WEB-E). TASK-014/021 tests stub the API with `page.route()`; the real two-window co-edit check runs in TASK-015's stack smoke and TASK-023's e2e against the compose stack.
- **Why:** the only runner that drives two real browsers; vitest cannot.

### Note 2 — container files (plan-check G2)
- **When:** 2026-11-25 · **File:** `docker-compose.yml`, `Dockerfile`, `.dockerignore`, `docker/documentserver/local.json`
- **Shape:** compose services `editing-service` (build `.`), `documentserver` (`onlyoffice/documentserver:8.2.2`, `JWT_ENABLED=true`, `JWT_SECRET`/`JWT_HEADER=Authorization`, `ALLOW_PRIVATE_IP_ADDRESS=true`), `db` (`postgres:16-alpine`); `env_file: .env` only (DO-B); `depends_on: condition: service_healthy` (DO-A); named volumes for pg data, version blobs, DS data/cache. Dockerfile: `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1`, multi-stage (build TS → runtime `node:20-alpine`), `npm ci`, non-root `USER node`, `HEALTHCHECK` on `/healthz` (DFL-A). `.dockerignore`: `.git node_modules dist .env* tests`. `local.json` mounted read-only at `/etc/onlyoffice/documentserver/local.json`: only `services.CoAuthoring.callbackBackoffOptions.retries = 6` and `services.CoAuthoring.request-filtering-agent.allowPrivateIPAddress = true`.
- **Why:** ADR D8; lint rules DFL-A / DO-A / DO-B.

### Note 3 — smoke requests file (plan-check G3)
- **When:** 2026-11-25 · **File:** `.astra/smoke-requests.json`
- **Shape:** the format `local-deploy-check.sh` reads (factory skill § "Local deploy config"): an object keyed `"METHOD /path"`, each `{ body?, query?, headers?, path_params?, expect?, save? }`; entries run in file order; `POST /dev/token` first with `"save": {"token": "$.token"}`, later entries use `"Authorization": "Bearer {{token}}"`. Every endpoint needs one success-path entry (FCT-I). Callback/content endpoints use `expect` for their documented success code.
- **Why:** FCT-I local deploy verification.

### Note 4 — migration naming (plan-check G4)
- **When:** 2026-11-25 · **File:** `drizzle.config.ts`, `drizzle/`
- **Decision:** `drizzle.config.ts` sets `migrations: { prefix: 'timestamp' }` so drizzle-kit writes `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_<name>.sql`, matching `database.md`. Generated with `drizzle-kit generate --name <description>`; never hand-renamed.
- **Why:** one naming rule, produced by the tool.
